locator.value: Root Data Entity page, subsection 'Direct properties of the Root Data Entity'
locator.quote: The Root Data Entity MUST have all of the properties listed below. […] `@type`: MUST be Dataset or an array that contains `Dataset` […] `datePublished`: MUST be a single string value in ISO 8601 date format
